quests.name: The Most Unexpected Friend
objectives: Take a picture of the dried-up flowers in Piglet's House .
Show Merlin the picture and explain what's going on.
Talk to Ursula .

Gather Ingredients to cook Honey-Glazed Plush Fish to impress Ursula :
  ‧ Plush Fish. Any vegetable. Golden Honey.
Cook Honey-Glazed Plush Fish to impress Ursula .
Make sure you have the Honey-Glazed Plush Fish in your Inventory.
Bring the Honey-Glazed Plush Fish to Ursula .
Talk to Winnie the Pooh about gift ideas.

Gather materials to craft the Rustic Jacuzzi :
  ‧ Driftwood. (8) Sweet Jelly. (2) Purple Thistle. (3) Red Thistle. (3) White Thistle. (3)
Craft Rustic Jacuzzi .
Talk to Piglet . He might have an idea to make the gift even better.

Take pictures of peaceful locations near water:
  ‧ In Drowsybloom Acre. In the Gloommeadow. In Braveheart Grove.
Show the photos to Piglet so he can choose the best spot.

Decorate any area in the Honeyglow Woods to suit Ursula 's tastes:
  ‧ Place Rustic Jacuzzi. Add any Rustic furniture. (2) Add any Delicate furniture. (2) Add any Wondrous furniture. (2)
Take a picture of the Rustic Jacuzzi in the decorated area.
Talk to Ursula and show her the photo.
Use Ursula's Flower Potion to upgrade your Watering Can .
Go inside Piglet's House to water the flowers.
Water Piglet's dried-up flowers with your Watering Can .
Talk to Piglet .

quests.name: After the Rain
objectives:
Gather materials to craft the Floating Umbrella :
  ‧ Driftwood. (1) Oak Leaves. (4) Tree Resin. (2)
Craft Floating Umbrella .
Make sure you have the Floating Umbrella in your Inventory.
Bring Floating Umbrella to Piglet .
Talk to WALL-E .

Reinforce river banks by planting:
  ‧ Pufflebud Pods by the river in Drowsybloom Acre. (5) Parsnip by the river in the Gloommeadow. (5) Golden Pattypan by the river in Braveheart Grove. (5)
Talk to Moana .

Gather materials to craft the Rainy Day Safety Kits for the Villagers:
  ‧ Driftwood. (8) Parsnip. (5) Purple & White Foxglove. (1) Rose & Cream Foxglove. (1) White & Pink Foxglove. (1) Yellow & Orange Foxglove. (1)
Craft Rainy Day Safety Kits . (5)
Make sure you have Rainy Day Safety Kits in your Inventory.
Bring Rainy Day Safety Kit to Piglet .
Visit Winnie the Pooh's House .
Talk to Winnie the Pooh .

Gather Ingredients to cook a tasty treat:
  ‧ Any Fish. (2) Any Protein. (2) Juniper Berry. (2) Truffle. (2) Golden Pattypan. (2)
Cook Foresty Quiche to share with WALL-E and Moana . (2)
Make sure you have Foresty Quiche the in your Inventory.
Bring Foresty Quiche to WALL-E .
Make sure you have Foresty Quiche the in your Inventory.
Bring Foresty Quiche to Moana .

quests.name: Collecting Little Wins
objectives: Talk to Joy .

Help Piglet tidy up the Honeyglow Woods by removing:
  ‧ Twistroots. (5) Amber Brushwoods. (5) Corrupted Honey Swirls. (5)
One little win down! Talk to Joy about your progress.
Make sure you have Golden Honey in your Inventory.
Share Golden Honey with The Beast .
Talk to Vanellope about her record-breaking race.

Grab some super-soft Safety Pillows from:
  ‧ Pooh's House. Piglet's House.
Make sure you have Safety Pillows in your Inventory.
Bring Safety Pillows to Piglet .

Use Furniture Mode to place the Safety Pillows to make each area safer:
  ‧ Drowsybloom Acre. The Gloommeadow. Braveheart Grove.
Talk to Piglet .
Put on Heroic Helmet .
Talk to Piglet and make sure everything is ready.
Follow Piglet to the starting point of the race near the Honeyglow Woods entrance .

Run the race route and check each section:
  ‧ In Drowsybloom Acre. In the Gloommeadow. Across the Pooh Sticks bridge. In Braveheart Grove. Near the Everoak Tree in Braveheart Grove.
Talk to Vanellope and friends after the race.

Gather materials to craft the Little Wins Leaderboard .
  ‧ Driftwood. (8) Purple & White Foxglove. (1) Rose & Cream Foxglove. (1) White & Pink Foxglove. (1) Yellow & Orange Foxglove. (1)
Craft Little Wins Leaderboard to celebrate Piglet 's little wins.
Place Little Wins Leaderboard anywhere in the Honeyglow Woods .
Take a photo with everyone to remember this moment!
Talk to Piglet to reflect on everything you've done.

quests.name: Piglet the Caretaker
objectives: Visit Piglet's House and start planning your next steps.
Talk to Piglet and friends inside Piglet's House.

Gather the Valley critters ' favorite treats:
  ‧ Peanut. Carrot. Blueberry.

Together with Piglet , feed the Valley's critters their favorite treats:
  ‧ Rabbit. Squirrel. Raccoon.
Talk to Piglet and friends about how it went with the critters .

Gather Ingredients to cook tasty treats for the new club members:
  ‧ Golden Honey. (3) Sweet Jelly. (3) Any grain. (3) Sweet Chestnut. (3)
Cook Honey Macarons to invite new Small Animal Care Club members. (3)

Invite Villagers to the Small Animal Care Club by sharing Honey Macarons :
  ‧ Pocahontas Kristoff Scar
Talk to Piglet about the club's next plans.

Gather materials to craft the Club Meeting Podium for the first meeting:
  ‧ Hardwood. (5) Driftwood. (4) Soft Limestone. (10) Purple Thistle. (2) White Thistle. (2)
Craft the Club Meeting Podium for the club's first meeting.

Decorate a meeting spot for the club's first gathering anywhere in the Honeyglow Woods :
  ‧ Place the Club Meeting Podium. (Optional) Add any furniture. (4)
Take a group photo to capture your first Small Animal Care Club meeting!
Talk to Piglet to reflect on your first meeting.
